documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by higher sales volumes, greater contribution from flat and stainless steel, and improved downstream integration. Revenue grew 33.4% year-on-year to INR5,960 crores in Q2 FY27, while PAT surged 96.2% year-on-year to INR511 crores. The company highlighted ongoing capacity expansions under Vision 2031, raw material security initiatives including the Phutamura coal block acquisition, and maintaining disciplined capital allocation supported by internal accruals and low net debt. Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited reported a consolidated revenue of Rs. 5,960.2 crore and profit after tax of Rs.

guidance.claim: By FY31, the company expects the stainless steel business to contribute approximately INR1,100 crores in EBITDA.
guidance.quote: By FY31, we expect this business to contribute approximately INR1,100 crores EBITDA from stainless steel and INR1,000 crores EBITDA from SBQ business, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company targets an RoE of 16% and RoCE of 24% by 2031.
guidance.quote: We continue to target RoE of 16% and RoCE of 24% by 2031.

guidance.claim: The company guided for a Return on Equity (RoE) of 16% and Return on Capital Employed (RoCE) of 24% by FY31.
guidance.quote: ~16% / 24% RoE / RoCE Growth in Revenue / EBITDA

guidance.claim: Management maintains a long-term EBITDA margin aspiration of around 14% to 15%.
guidance.quote: Even at this scale, our long-term EBITDA margin aspiration of around 14% to 15% remain very conservative considering that we are already operating at close to 13% to 14% EBITDA margin with several high-value business yet to contribute.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering a 600 to 700 basis point improvement in return on equity and return on capital by 2031.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering a 600 to 700 basis point improvement in return on equity and return on capital by 2031, supported by higher utilization, richer value-added product portfolio and increasing contributions from our downstream businesses.

demand_outlook.claim: The World Steel Association October outlook projected broadly flat global steel demand in 2026, followed by 1.7% growth in 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: The World Steel Association October outlook projected broadly flat global steel demand in 2026, followed by 1.7% growth in 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: India remains the major source of growth with demand expected to increase 7.9% in 2026 and 8% in 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: India remains the major source of growth with the demand expected to increase 7.9% in 2026 and 8% in 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the GoI has issued a circular for the use of stainless steel in national highway bridges and centrally sponsored projects in marine environments.
demand_outlook.quote: GoI has issued circular for use of stainless steel for construction of national highway Bridges and centrally sponsored projects in marine environment susceptible to sever corrosion

demand_outlook.claim: In India, demand continues to remain healthy, driven by government-led infrastructure development, railway modernization, urbanization, manufacturing expansion, and domestic value addition.
demand_outlook.quote: In India, demand continues to remain healthy, driven by the growth. And as we know, our country being a developing nation, the fast treasury growth of last 10 years has witnessed the growth across the sector by the government-led infrastructure development, railway modernization, urbanization, manufacturing expansion and increasing focus on domestic value addition.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to witness healthy demand across several product categories.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to witness healthy demand across several product categories, enabling us to further strengthen our market position.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR2,700 crores in an expansion in the Odisha plant for stainless steel.
capex_expansion.quote: Stainless steel represents our other significant opportunity where we are diversifying by investing INR2,700 crores expansion in our Odisha plant, with complete downstream processing capability together is scheduled both to be commissioned target by March 2029, including the SBQ plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The estimated capex for the Alom Solar Private Limited project is INR360 crores, with the company's share close to INR185 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The estimated capex for the said project is going to be INR360 crores, where our share is going to be close to INR185 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly commissioned solar plant in Jamuria has a capacity of close to 9 megawatts.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly commissioned solar plant of close to 9 megawatts in Jamuria will increase the renewable energy use, support lower power cost, and reduce emissions from our operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned an 18,000 tons per annum aluminum foil facility at Sambalpur in July, taking total foil capacity to approximately 42,000 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: In July, we commissioned 18,000 tons per annum of aluminum foil facility at Sambalpur, taking total foil capacity to approximately 42,000 tons per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 1.5 million ton beneficiation plant at Sambalpur with an investment of INR150 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this downstream expenses, we commissioned a 1.5 million ton of beneficiation plant at Sambalpur with an investment of INR150 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects production from the Phutamura coal block to commence in July 2027.
The company incurred a total capex of Rs. 9,921 crores since listing.
capex_expansion.quote: Since listing, the Company has incurred Capex of Rs. 9,921 crores, representing 53% of the total planned CAPEX of Rs.18,785 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incurred INR575 crores during the quarter towards ongoing expansion projects.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capital expenditure front, we incurred INR575 crores during this quarter towards our ongoing expansion project.

capex_expansion.claim: The balance approximately INR9,580 crores of announced capex is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years.
capex_expansion.quote: Going forward, the balance approximately INR9,580 crores of our announced capex is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years across our planned project.

capex_expansion.claim: The color-coated plant was successfully commissioned in April 2026, increasing cold rolling capacity by 60% from 0.25 million ton to 0.4 million ton.
capex_expansion.quote: We are pleased to share the successful commissioning of our color coated plant in April 2026, which increased our cold rolling capacity by 60% from 0.25 metric ton to 0.4 metric ton -- million ton.

capex_expansion.claim: The company acquired a 26% equity stake in Emerge Green Power Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, Shyam Metalics acquired 26% equity stake in Emerge Green Power Private Limited, which is constantly becoming an associate company of the company.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, EBITDA increased 40.9% year-on-year to INR857 crores with a margin of 14.4%.
margins_costs.quote: Similarly, the EBITDA increased 40.9% on year-on-year basis and 5.5% on quarter-on-quarter basis, which stood at INR857 crores, with a margin of 14.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA, excluding other income, grew 52.6% year-on-year to INR823 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Operating EBITDA, excluding the other income, grew 52.6% on year-on-year basis and 7.5% on quarter-on-quarter basis to INR823 crores.

margins_costs.claim: The operating EBITDA margin expanded by 170 bps year-on-year to 13.8%.
margins_costs.quote: The operating EBITDA margin expanded by 170 bps year-on-year basis to 13.8%.

margins_costs.claim: For the first half of the current financial year, EBITDA increased 34.4% to INR1,670 crores with a margin of 14.6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased 34.4% to INR1,670 crores with a margin of 14.6%.

margins_costs.claim: The cost of captive power was Rs. 2.44 per unit.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of in-house power (₹2.44 Per Unit) is significantly less than grid power which costs ₹5-7 Per Unit

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 80% of power was sourced from captive power plants.
margins_costs.quote: ~80% of Captive Power in Q2 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Operating EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 was reported at 13.8%.
Gross profit margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 29.0%.
Revenue grew by 23% year-on-year to approximately INR5,500 crores while EBITDA and PAT increased by 28% and 21% respectively in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: During Q1 FY27, the revenue grew by 23% year-on-year to approximately INR5,500 crores, while EBITDA and PAT also followed an increase by 28% and 21%, respectively.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin expanded by 100 basis points on a year-on-year basis.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded by 100 basis points on a year-on-year basis, reflecting sustained operational efficiency on the back of cost optimization, improved product mix, benefiting from our integrated operations and focusing more on B2C and value-added product, innovation and values.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR351 crores, reflecting a growth of 20.6% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax for the quarter stood at INR351 crores, reflecting a growth of 20.6% on a year-on-year basis, and 12.6% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume increased by 26% year-on-year to 15.49 lakh tons in Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: The total sales volume increased by 26% on year-on basis to 15.49 lakh tons in quarter 2 of the current financial year, taking first half of volume is INR29.32 lakh tons, up from 20%.

orders_capacity.claim: Carbon steel flat product sales more than doubled year-on-year to approximately 81,500 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: The carbon steel flat product sales more than double year-on-year basis to approximately 81,500 tons, while stainless steel volume grew by 20.7% to approximately 29,850 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has almost close to more than 10 months order bookings from its existing foil plant.
orders_capacity.quote: We have almost close to more than 10 months order bookings from our existing foil plant.

capital_allocation.claim: During the first half, the company recorded a strong operating cash flow of INR1,544 crores, covering a capital expenditure of INR1,291 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our earnings performance was accompanied by a strong operating cash flow of INR1,544 crores during the first half, covering a capital expenditure of INR1,291 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Since listing, the company has incurred a capital expenditure of INR9,921 crores, representing approximately 53% of the total planned capex of INR18,785 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Since listing, the company has incurred a capital expenditure of INR9,921 crores, representing approximately 53% of the total planned capex of INR18,785 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: During the quarter, the company incurred a capex of INR716 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During the quarter, we incurred a capex of INR716 crores, reflecting our continuous focus on executing the planned capital investment program and strengthening our operational capability.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 2026, working capital stood at a negative 16 days.
capital_allocation.quote: As of September 2026, the working capital stood at a negative 16 days, supporting efficient utilization of capital and liquidity.

capital_allocation.claim: The net debt remained modest at INR192 crores as of September 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: The net debt remained modest at INR192 crores, providing a flexibility to meet our investment requirement while maintaining the prudent leverage.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared an interim dividend of INR1.8 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to say that our Board has declared an interim dividend of INR1.8 per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: Globally, the metal industry continues to witness volatility due to fluctuations in prices, trade flows, and geopolitical developments.
risks_headwinds.quote: Globally, the metal industry continues to witness volatility due to the fluctuation in the prices, trade flow, geopolitical development.

management_commitments.claim: The stainless steel plant with complete downstream processing capability together with the SBQ plant is scheduled to be commissioned by March 2029.
management_commitments.quote: Stainless steel represents our other significant opportunity where we are diversifying by investing INR2,700 crores expansion in our Odisha plant, with complete downstream processing capability together is scheduled both to be commissioned target by March 2029, including the SBQ plant.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the Phutamura coal block is expected by July 2027.
management_commitments.quote: With estimate reserve of 170 million tons and the production expected by July 2027, the block will support long-term captive coal requirement and reduce the dependency on the external sources.

management_commitments.claim: The initiative of acquiring a 51% controlling stake in Alom Solar Private Limited is expected to generate an incremental EBITDA of close to INR400 crores by FY31.
management_commitments.quote: An initiative is expected to generate an incremental EBITDA of close to INR400 crores by FY31.

management_commitments.claim: The balance planned capex of approximately INR8,864 crores is expected to be deployed over the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: The balance planned capex of approximately INR8,864 crores is expected to be deployed over the next 2 to 3 years, and which is also through our internal accrual, and which is also in line with the project execution timelines.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects production from the Phutamura coal block to commence in July 2027.
The aluminium flat roll product projects remain on track for commissioning during the second quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The aluminium flat roll product projects remain on track for commissioning during the second quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The balance approximately INR9,580 crores of announced capex is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years across planned projects.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, the balance approximately INR9,580 crores of our announced capex is expected to be deployed over the next 3 to 4 years across our planned project.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to deliver a 600 to 700 basis point improvement in return on equity and return on capital by 2031.
management_commitments.quote: We remain confident of delivering a 600 to 700 basis point improvement in return on equity and return on capital by 2031, supported by higher utilization, richer value-added product portfolio and increasing contributions from our downstream businesses.
